info.name: Generazione X
info.plot: Brodie e T.S. sono stati scaricati dalle loro rispettive ragazze. Decidono così di passare una giornata bighellonando in un centro commerciale dove, con l'aiuto di Jay e Silent Bob, due punk combinaguai, tenteranno di riconquistare le ex-ragazze.

translations.overview: Both dumped by their girlfriends, two best friends seek refuge in the local mall. Eventually, they decide to try and win back their significant others and take care of their respective nemeses.
translations.tagline: They're not there to shop. They're not there to work. They're just there.
